name: Bitwise Hamming Condition
description: Replaces the base-(k+1) superincreasing capacity sequence with a requirement that the sum of 2^{x} for the exactly k chosen paths equals 2^{k+1}-2 (and similarly for y and z). Since the target has Hamming weight k, and we sum exactly k terms, this uniquely forces the values to be exactly a permutation of 1..k. This is mathematically strictly equivalent to Exact Cover. It defeats the LLM because without recognizing this uniqueness, a naive sum-checking backtrack will TLE, whereas the previous superincreasing sequence was a well-known pattern that LLMs map to Exact Cover.
